{{Otheruses|Gank}}
{{Quote|Our signature menu item, served fresh off the grill! We start with a perfectly seasoned, hand-formed, 100 percent pure Mongo Beefhead patty--no additives or Gank fillers here--served on the finest trans-shipped, medium-density food-board available.|Dex's Diner menu, on its Mongo beefhead patties|<ref name="Menu">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>}}
'''Gank fillers''' were a type of food additive. The menu of [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], an [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], stated that the [[Mongo Beefhead patty|Mongo beefhead patties]] used in its [[slider]]s contained no gank fillers.<ref name="Menu" /> The filler shared its name with [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Gank/Legends|Gank]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Gank fillers were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
